description: This Java interface defines a contract for objects that encapsulate session-related JSON data in a streaming context, including methods for retrieving JSON content, headers, and creating sessioned JSON objects for signals, errors, responses, subscriptions, and acknowledgements.

classes.name: SessionedJsonifiable
classes.description: An interface for JSON objects associated with streaming sessions, providing methods to retrieve JSON content, headers, and factory methods for creating sessioned JSON objects for various scenarios.

methods.name: getJsonifiable
methods.description: Returns the JSON content with predicate filtering.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the JSON object.

methods.name: retrieveExtraFields
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves additional fields for the JSON object based on session info.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns an optional streaming session if available.

methods.name: signal
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSON object for a signal.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSON object for an error.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSON object for a response.

methods.name: subscription
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSON object for a subscription event.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSON object for a streaming acknowledgement.
